s: puM, (apa + car + BAve GaY, apaTyasevanaM .) ahitAcaraRaM । yaTA, “yonipradozAcca Bavanti SiSne paYcopadaMSA viviDApacArEH” । iti mADavakaraH । (“kftApacAro'pi parEranAvizkftavikriyaH । asADyaM kurute kopaM prApte kAle gado yaTA” ॥ iti mAGaH .)
v: pu॰ apa + cara--BAve GaY । ahitAcaraRe apaTyasevane “kftApacAro'pi parEranAvizkftavikriyaH । asADyaM kurute kopaM prApte kAle gado yaTeti” mAGaH । “apacAraH apakAraH apaTyaYceti” malli॰ । “yonipradozAcca Bavanti SiSne paYcopadaMSA viviDApacArEriti” vEdya॰ । vEparItyAdihetukadoze “nApacAramagaman kvacit kriyA” iti mAGaH । “apacAraM lopavizayaviparyyAsAdidozamiti” malli॰ । vinASe ca “mahADvare viDyapacAradoza” iti kirA॰ । “apacAraH karmmalopadoza” iti malli॰ । “mudgApacAre mAzapratiniDAviti” mImAMsA । apakarmmaRi ca “gUhamAnA'pacAraM sA banDupakzaBayAttadA” BA॰ A॰ pa॰ 111 a॰ ।
m: अप-चार m. want, absence
defect
fault, improper conduct, offence
unwholesome or improper regimen.
a: अपचारः — 1 Departure; death; सिंहघोषश्च कांतकापचारं निर्भिद्य Dk. 72. --2 Want, absence. --3 A fault; offence, misdeed, improper conduct, crime; शिष्यो गुराविव कृतप्रथमापचारः Mv. 4. 20; न राजापचारमंतरेण U. 2 (v. l. for ˚अपराधं); राजन्प्रजासु ते कश्चिदपचारः प्रवर्तते R. 15. 47. --4 Injurious or hurtful conduct, injury, Ve. 4. 10. --5 A defect, flaw, failure, deficiency; नापचारमगमन् क्वचित्क्रियाः Śi. 14. 32; mistake, omission (to do a thing) (लोप); महाध्वरे विध्यपचारदोषः Ki. 16. 48. --6 Unwholesome or improper regimen (अपथ्य); कृतापचारोपि परैरनाविष्कृतविक्रियः . असाध्यः कुरुते कोपं प्राप्ते काले गदो यथा .. Śi. 2. 84 (where अ˚ also means hurt or injury).

v: tri॰ apa + cara--tacCIlArTe karttari GinuR । apakarmmakaraRaSIle striyAM NIp । “patyO BAryyApacAriRIti” manuH । “BAryyA apacAriRI vyaBicAriRI jArapatiM kzamamARe Barttari pApaM saMSlezayatIti” kullUkaBawwaH ।
m: अप-चारिन् mfn. departing from, disbelieving in, infidel, Mn.
doing wrong, wicked.
a: अपचारिन् — a. Offending, doing wrong; wicked, bad; भार्यापचारिणी Ms. 8. 317 a faithless wife.

m: अप-√ चाय् to fear, TBr.; to respect, honour, ŚBr.; TBr.
a: अपचाय् — {c1c} A. 1 To fear. --2 To respect, honour, worship.

m: अप-चायक mfn. honouring, Divyāv.
अप-चायिन् mfn. not rendering due respect, showing want of respect, MBh.

s: tri, (apa + cAya + karmmaRi ktaH .) pUjitaH । ityamaraH ।
m: अप-चायित mfn. honoured, respected, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 30, Sch.

k.v: ऊतं स्यूतमुतं चेति त्रितयं तन्तुसन्तते। स्यादर्हिते नमस्यितनमसितमपचायितार्चितापचितम्.।

m: अप-च्छाया f. an unlucky shadow, a phantom, apparition.

s: tri, (apagatA CAyA yasmAt saH .) devaH । upadevaH । nizpraBaH । apagatA CAyA yasmAt iti bahuvrIhO hrasvaH । (apakfzwacCAyAviSizwaH । piSAcAdiH । “ajAKuraM KurotsargamArjjanIreRuvajjanEH । dIpaKawvApacCAyeva tyajyate nirDanojanaH” .)
v: pu॰ apagatA dehacCAyA kAntirvAsya prA॰ ba॰ vA gatalopaSca । deve dehacCAyASUnyatvAttezAmapacCAyatvam । ataeva “Bajantu rUpaM kiyadasya devASCAyA nalasyAsti taTApi nEzAm । itIrayantIva taTA nirEkzi sA (CAyA) nEzaDe natvamarezu tezu” iti nEzaDe devAnAM CAyArAhityaM lakzaRatvena varRRitam । apagatakAntO tri॰ ।
m: अप-च्छाय mfn. shadowless, having no shadow (as a deity or celestial being)
having a bad or unlucky shadow
a: अपच्छाय — a. [अपगता छाया यस्मात्] 1 Shadowless. --2 Having a bad or unlucky shadow. --3 Devoid of brightness, dim. --यः One that has no shadow, i. e. a god; cf. N. 14. 21; श्रियं भजंतां कियदस्य देवाश्छाया नलस्यास्ति तथापि नैषाम् . इतीरयंतीव तया निरैक्षि सा (छाया) नैषधे न त्रिदशेषु तेषु .. --या An unlucky shadow, apparition, phantom.

m: अप-च्छद् (√ छद्), Caus. -च्छादयति to take off a cover, ĀpŚr.

a: अपच्छत्र — a. Without a parasol or umbrella.

m: अप-च्छत्त्र mfn. not having a parasol, Kathās.
अप-च्छेद m. n. cutting off or away
separation.
a: अपच्छेदः --दनं — 1 Cutting off or away. --2 Loss. --3 Interruption.

m: अप-च्छेदन n. id.
1. अप-च्छिद् (√ छिद्) to cut off or away, ŚBr. &c.
2. अप-च्छिद् f. a cutting, shred, chip, ŚBr.; PBr.

v: strI apakfzwaM pacyate'sO paca--karmakarttari ac aprASantye na॰ ta॰ gO॰ NIz । gaRqamAloparijAte rogaBede “aTAto'granTyapacyarvudagaRqamAlAnAM nidAnaM vyAKyAsyAma” ityupakramya “ananyavarRRErupacIyamAnaM cayaprakarzAdapacIMvadanti kaRqUyanAnte'lparujAH praBinnAH sravanti naSyanti Bavanti cAnye” iti suSrute tallakzaRamuktam । “te granTayo kecidanAptapAkAH sravanti naSyanti Bavanti cAnye । kAlAnubanDaM ciramAdaGAti sEvApacIti pravadanti keciditi” vE॰ “nAqIM kaPAnilakftAmapacIM vraRAMSceti” apacIM gaRqamAlAM ca grahaRIM SoTameva veti” casuSrutaH ।
m: अप-ची f. a disease consisting in an enlargement of the glands of the neck, Suśr.
a: अपची — [अपकृष्टं पच्यते असौ, पच् कर्मकर्तरि अच् गौरा˚ ङीष्] A disease in which the glands of the neck are enlarged and swollen.

v: pu॰ na paktuM SaktaH paca--“ackAvaSaktAviti” pA॰ । ac । paktumaSakte । “apacaH paktumaSakta” iti si॰ kO॰ ।
m: अ-पच mfn. not able to cook, a bad cook, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 157 seq. Sch.
a: अपचः — [पक्तुमशक्तः Sk.] 1 Unable to cook, or one who does not cook for himself. --2 A bad cook, a term of abuse (आक्रोशे); अपचो जाल्मः P. VI. 2. 157-8 Sk.

m: अ-प—˚चमान (Mn.), mfn. one who does not cook for himself.
अ-प—˚चमानक (Gaut.), mfn. one who does not cook for himself.
अ-पचन n. the not being cooked, MBh. ix, 2780
अप-√ चर् to depart; to act wrongly.
a: अपचर् — {c1c} P. 1 To depart. --2 To go astray, transgress; offend, commit a fault, act wrongly; यो यस्तेषामपचरेत्तमाचक्षीत वै द्विजः Mb.; तदंगनास्वपाचरन्नरेंद्रः Dk. 162 outraged.

v: na॰ apakfzwaM caritaM prA॰ sa॰ । apakfzwacarite sadozAcaraRe, “Ahosvit prasavo mamApacaritErvizwamBito vIruDAmiti” Saku॰ ।
m: अप-चरित mfn. gone away, departed, dead
अप-चरित n. fault, offence, Śāk.
a: अपचरित — p. p. Gone away, departed; deceased. --तं A fault, wrong or wicked deed, misdeed; आहोस्वित्प्रसवो ममापचरितैर्विष्टंभितो वीरुधां Ś. 5. 9.

s: puM, (apa + ci + BAve ac । apaharaRaM .) kzatiH । hAniH । tatparyyAyaH । apahAraH 2 । ityamaraH ॥ (pUjA sammAnanA । kzayaH । “dehasyApacayomatO niviSate gAQo gfhezu grahaH” । iti SAntiSatake .)
v: pu॰ apa + ci BAve ac । hAnO, apaharaRe, vyaye ca ।
m: अप-चय m. diminution, decay, decrease, decline
N. of several planetary mansions.
a: अपचयः — 1 Diminution, decrease, decay, decline, fall (fig. also.); कफापचयः Dk. 160; तेनास्यापचयं यांति व्याधेर्मूलान्यशेषतः Suśr.; H. 3. 130; defeat Mv. 2. 13. --2 Loss, privation, failure, defect; H. 3. 133. --3 N. of several planetary mansions.

k.v: अपहारस्त्वपचयः समाहारः समुच्चयः। प्रत्याहार उपादानं विहारस्तु परिक्रमः॥

m: अप-चेतस् mfn. not favourable to (with abl.), TBr.
averse from (abl.), TBr.
अप-चेतृ m. a spendthrift, L.
1. अप-√ 2. चि (Imper. 2. sg. -चिकीहि) to pay attention to, to respect, AV. i, 10, 4.
2. अप-√ 1. चि -चिनोति, to gather, collect: Pass. -चीयते, to be injured in health or prosperity; to grow less; to wane; (with abl.) to lose anything, MBh.
a: अपचि — {c3c} P. 1 To honour, respect. --2 To invite respectfully. --3 ({c5c} U.) To gather, collect. --pass. 1 To be reduced in strength or bulk, sink, waste away; अपचितमपि गात्रं व्यायतत्वादलक्ष्यं Ś. 2. 9 reduced in bulk, emaciated, lean; to wane, decline, diminish, grow less; राजहंस तव सैव शुभ्रता चीयते न च न चापचीयते K. P. 10. --2 To fall away from, be deprived of, lose (with abl.) प्रकृतिः सूयते तद्वदानंत्यान्नापचीयते Mb.

v: strI apakarttumicCA apa + kf--san--BAve striyAm a । apakarttumicCAyAm ।
m: अप-चिकीर्षा f. (√ 1. कृ Desid.), desire of hurting any one.
अप-चिकीर्षु mfn. wishing to do harm or injury, KāśīKh.

v: tri॰ apa + ci--kvip । apacayakArake । “itastAH sarvAnaSyantu bADakA apacitAmiva” aTa॰ 6, 25, 1 ।
m: 1. अप-√ चित् Caus. Ā. (Subj. -चेतयातै) to abandon, turn off from (abl.), VS. ii, 17 : Desid. -चिकित्सति, to wish to leave or to abandon any one (abl.), AV. xiii, 2, 15.
2. अप-चित् त्, f. a noxious flying insect, AV.
(read, ‘a sore, boil’, = अप-ची, fr. 2. अप-√ चि, AV.
a: अपचित् — f. A noxious flying insect; that which causes decay.

s: tri, (apa + cAya + pUjArTe karmmaRi ktaH । apacitaSceti pARinisUtrena pakze cAyasTAne ciBAbaH । apa + ci + ktaH .) hInaH । vyayitaH । avayavAdyapacayayuktaH । kzIRaH । kfSaH । “apacitamapi gAtraM vyAyatatvAdalakzyaM” । iti SAkuntale ।
v: tri॰ apacAyyate Anandena pUjyate cAya--pUjanAdO kta cAyateSciH apaSabdasyAnandapUrvvakatvam । Anandena pUjite । pUjito hi AnandapUrvvakaM pUjyate । apa + cikta । jAtApacaye avayavAdyapacayayukte, hIne, vyayite ca । “tatrApacitavalAH prARinoBavanti” suSrutaH ।
m: 1. अप-चित mfn. (Pāṇ. vii, 2, 30) honoured, respected, ŚBr. &c.
respectfully invited, BhP.
अप-चित n. honouring, esteeming.
2. अप-चित mfn. diminished, expended, wasted
emaciated, thin, Śāk. &c.
a: अपचित — p. p. 1 Reduced in bulk, decreased, wasted, expended &c.; emaciated, thin, lean. --2 Honoured, respected, saluted --तं Honouring.

k.v: ऊतं स्यूतमुतं चेति त्रितयं तन्तुसन्तते। स्यादर्हिते नमस्यितनमसितमपचायितार्चितापचितम्.।

s: strI, (apa + ci + BAve ktin । hAniH । vyayaH । pUjA । nizkftiH । iti medinI । (kzayaH । DvaMsaH । sammAnanA । “ahaM tvapacitiM BrAtuH pituSca sakalAmimAM” । iti rAmAyaRe .)
v: strI॰ apa + cAya--ktin cAyateSciH । pUjAyAm “vihitApacitirmahIBftA” iti mAGaH । apa + ci--ktin । apacaye hInatAyAm, apakzayarUpaBAvavikAraBede ca ।
m: 1. अप-चिति f. honouring, reverence, Śiś.
2. अप-चिति f. loss, L.
expense, L.
N. of a daughter of Marīci, VP.
(for 3. अप-चिति See below.)
3. अप-चिति f. (= ἀπότισις, √ 3. चि), compensation, either recompense [TS. &c.] or retaliation, revenge, punishing, RV. iv, 28, 4, &c.
a: अपचितिः — f. (P. VII. 2. 30 Vārt.) 1 Loss, decay, decline, destruction. --2 Expense. --3 Atonement, amends, compensation, expiation of sin. --4 Exclusion. --5 Punishing. --6 N. of a daughter of Marīci. --7 Honouring, worshipping, showing reverence, worship; विहितापचितिर्महीभृता Śi. 16. 9 (where it also means loss, destruction हानि), 1. 17; 15. 34; K. 324; Ki. 6. 46; 11. 9.

k.v: स्युरावेशिक आगन्तुरतिथिर्ना गृहागते। प्राघूर्णिकः प्राघूणकश्चाभ्युत्थानं तु गौरवम्. पूजा नमस्यापचितिः सपर्यार्चार्हणाः समाः॥

m: अप-चिति—मत् (अपचिति-), mfn. honoured, TS.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.

v: pu॰ apa + cyuN--gatO BAve ap । apasaraRe nirgamane “yatra nAryyapacyavamupacyavaYca Sikzate” iti f॰ 1, 28, 3 “apacyavyaM SAlAyAnirgamamiti” BA॰ । apa--cyu--kzaraRe, ap । apakzaraRe ।
m: अप-च्यव m. pushing away, RV. i, 28, 3.
a: अपच्यवः — Going or coming out (निर्गम); Rv. 1. 28. 3.

m: अप-√ च्यु (aor. Ā. 2. sg. -च्योष्ठः) to fall off, go off, desert, RV. x, 173, 2 : Caus. (aor. -चुच्यवत्) to expel, RV. ii, 41, 10.
a: अपच्यु — {c1c} A. 1 To fall off, go away or off, withdraw, desert. --2 To perish, die.

v: tri॰ apa + cyu--karttari kta । apakzayaprApte nazwaprAyekzarite ca ।
a: अपच्युत — p. p. Fallen off; departed, perished; melted away.
